notes.title: NOISZ reV2.4 (The New Engine Update)
notes.content:
It's been a while, hasn't it...? For NOISZ's 5th anniversary, we've rebuilt the game in GMS2! It's hard to convey just how much effort has gone into this undertaking, so we'll just focus on what that means for everyone else...

In most cases, you can expect substantial performance gains relative to older versions of the game! It's also made it possible to bring back the Mac version, along with a certain other heavily-anticipated port which... isn't quite ready yet for the occasion, but it's coming soon!

Please note that the revamped first-boot sequence (normally shown to new players) will appear for everyone once, so your data is safe!

The demo has also been updated, so prospective players will experience the same changes.

In any case, thank you all for playing NOISZ! I'd say something like "here's to 5 more years", but we're looking to bring the series to its finale soonish. Please look forward to an epic conclusion instead...!?

(And of course, next month, we'll be launching a new story DLC for the game, NOISZ episode G! Please wishlist it if you'd like...!)

notes.title: NOISZ reV2.3 (The Big Story and Accessibility Update)
notes.content:
NOISZ reV2.3 has been released, bringing a number of new accessibility and QoL features, as well as a rewrite of the game's original campaign, NOISZ Ignition!

[b]Updated Story[/b]
NOISZ Ignition features tighter writing and connects more seamlessly to its successors, re:||VERSE and STΔRLIVHT. It's an improved experience for newcomers, and worth discovering all over again for veterans!

[b]New Accessibility Functions[/b]
Two new assist features have been added: Super Easy mode grants complete invincibility throughout the entire story campaign, while Route Assist automatically selects all dialogue choices which have a significant impact on the story, guaranteeing you the ending of your choice (if your rhythm bullet hell skills are up to the task, at least).

These features will help players struggling with the bullet hell and VN aspects of the game, respectively; Dancer Style, which has been in the game from its initial release, is an assist feature for its rhythm element. Choose to engage with the parts of NOISZ that appeal to you! You can even turn on all three, kick back, and just enjoy the story.

[b]Speedrun Challenges[/b]
Another special Story Mode variant Luna Rush has been added, which is all about going fast! But also not dying! Each stage is timed, and to stop the clock, you'll want to reach Overflow as quickly as possible. But you'll permanently have Lunatic Module equipped, causing you to restart the Verse on taking damage! A wild new challenge for our mightiest veterans.

[b]Base Game QoL Updates[/b]
Several features included with the re:||VERSE expansion have been backported to the base game! Notably, Style Lab is available, letting you customize your abilities before battle!

[b]Massively Expanded Demo[/b]
You can now play the entirety of Story A for free in NOISZ's demo! Tell all your friends to try it out~

notes.title: NOISZ reV2.2 (Anniversary Update): Now in Japanese
notes.content:
NOISZ re:||VERSE is now 1 year old! We're celebrating with a new update that brings full Japanese support, as well as some smaller fixes and balance changes. We'll be working to bring NOISZ to you in more languages in the future as well!

Quick changelog:
[list]
[*] reV Story and UI localized to Japanese
[*] Parry variants with 1 max life no longer keep combo on reaching Overflow with exactly 64 combo
[*] reV (stage) pattern difficulty reduced on Easy and Normal, boss HP -5%
[*] Quicksilver boss HP in verse 2 -10% and verse timer more reliable, player damage output +10%
[*] In π・ρ・maniac, using Harmonic's red shield will cause you to take damage from the correct answer laser (and not the wrong answer). Score saving on this stage has now been enabled for Harmonic
[/list]

notes.title: NOISZ v2.1 Performance Update
notes.content:
NOISZ's performance update is now live, addressing start of stage and intermittent lag issues! This version should cover the most common performance problems players have experienced, and we hope it ensures a smooth experience for you.

If you encounter any new problems relating to the update, please let us know! You can use the "legacy" build (in the betas menu) to switch back to the previous version if needed.

notes.title: NOISZ version 1.5 update now live!
notes.content:
NOISZ's massive 1.5 update is now available! We've upgraded various aspects of the game in preparation for our upcoming re:||VERSE expansion:

[list]
[*] New Story art
[*] Expanded Artist Packs
[*] Sprite updates
[*] ADV tutorials
[*] COINZ revamp
[*] Style balance changes
[*] UI updates
[/list]

Thank you for playing and we hope you enjoy rediscovering NOISZ!
